prodNeverPaused: This project is marked production, so it is never paused.
signInToSee: Sign in to SnoutData to see your hosted databases.
noHosted: This account has no hosted databases yet.
askedStop: Asked it to stop. This takes a few seconds.
askedStart: Asked it to start. This takes a few seconds.
createdNoConn: Created {ref}. It is starting. Adding it as a connection failed ({detail}); use Import to add it.
createdConn: Created {ref} and added it as a connection. It is starting, which takes about half a minute.
askedDelete: Asked it to delete. This takes a few seconds.
notInAccount: This project is not in your account any more.
keysStopWorking: Every key already in use stops working.
pushUnavailable: Push is not available on SnoutData Cloud yet.
pushRestarts: Turned on. Push runs beside the database, so the database restarts once, within a minute.
imageOrBuild: A deploy is an image or a build, not both.
noPassword: You sign in to this project as yourself, so it has no password to copy.
noApiKeys: This project has no API keys yet. Try again in a moment.
dbSilent: The database is not answering on 127.0.0.1:{port}. Is the project running?
keysUnreadable: This project's API keys could not be read just now. Try again in a moment.
noCall: The app does not call {path} for you.
gatewaySilent: The gateway did not answer at {where} ({error})
ownKeyRefused: The project refused its own server key.
overQuota: over its storage quota, so it is refusing writes
pausedWakes: paused, so the first connection wakes it and takes a few seconds
signInToImport: Sign in to SnoutData to import your hosted databases.
noHostedCreate: This account has no hosted databases yet. Create one from the Cloud panel.
